::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bengaluru (Indiranagar) firm, incorporated Jan 2025 per registry data, offering end-to-end IC design services, custom IP and pin-to-pin compatible replacement ICs (no parts named). Its one detailed product is 'ESD Monitron', a factory ESD-monitoring hardware and software system, not a chip. Says it is DLI-approved. No chip tape-out, part or customer publicly reported.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Pin-to-pin compatible ICs, power-gate and custom IP, and ESD-monitoring systems.
